findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 is not covered by real two-host evidence. checklist_get records only a manual_transcript with command "claude --print ...; codex exec -s read-only ..." and no file/transcript artifact; evidence_inspect confirms the only transcriptRef for this intent is checklist.verificationEvidence. The final document honestly states the two-host/Authority limitation, but the required proof that Claude CLI and Codex CLI each produced bounded drafts is currently an assertion rather than inspectable evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Added inspectable Host Transcript Evidence section with Claude/Codex exact command trail and captured draft excerpts; CHK-002:happy evidence now points to rg checks over that section.

findings.desc: NAV is not fully synchronized after this story adds a decision guide. docs/requirements/NAV.md was updated from 40 to 41 files and includes the new F-009 link at line 16, but there are currently 42 Markdown files under docs/requirements/decisions while NAV has 41 decision links; the missing link is decisions/formal-unlock-artifact-isolation-execution-plan.md.
